en.headline: Seven hurt after minibus and van collide in Sha Tin
en.dek: A green minibus driver and six passengers were injured when the vehicle struck a van on Sha Tin Rural Committee Road at 9.13am on Tuesday.
body: Seven people were injured in Sha Tin on Tuesday morning after a green public light bus collided with a van on Sha Tin Rural Committee Road, local media reported.

Oriental Daily News said the crash happened at 9.13am. The minibus driver and six passengers were hurt and were treated at the scene by ambulance crews. The cause of the collision was still under investigation.
Traffic around the site was held up after the crash. Police have not issued a detailed statement on injuries or hospital destinations.

zh.headline: 沙田鄉事會路小巴客貨車相撞 七人受傷
zh.dek: 一輛專線小巴周二上午9時13分在沙田鄉事會路與客貨車相撞，小巴司機及六名乘客受傷，原因待查。
body: 沙田周二早上發生交通意外，一輛專線小巴與一輛客貨車在沙田鄉事會路相撞，據本地傳媒報道共七人受傷。
《東方日報》報道，意外發生於上午9時13分，小巴司機及六名乘客受傷，正接受在場救護員治理，意外原因有待調查。
現場交通一度受阻。警方尚未公布傷者送院詳情。
